A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (2 March 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata for this card; Decipher published no errata text for it.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-exposure-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Exposure (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”. Same words as before.

The whole earlier card image and the whole of this card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
